'''Hypnostrix''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Chronerva]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Time is a cycle that nudges the hands of fate. When the pendulum swings back, we'll be reunited with those we've lost."

Hypnostrix is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
Hypnostrix is a green, white, and yellow griffin creature. It has massive wings and an abstract nimbus arch surrounding its head. On its chest is a single gold analog clock hand pointing up.

Hypnostrix's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its green feathers with pink. 

== Trivia ==
* Hypnostrix and its evolutions were added to the game on 5/12/2026 alongside [[Pandagrand]] and [[Sealord]].
